# ScoreMax Tutoring

> ScoreMax is a US tutoring company offering one-to-one test preparation and academic
> tutoring. All tutoring is 100% online: every session is held live over video
> conferencing, and students receive a private video link for each booking. ScoreMax
> does not offer in-person or in-home tutoring.

Site: https://www.scoremaxtutoring.com

## What ScoreMax offers

- **Test preparation** — SAT, ACT, LSAT, GRE and GMAT, taught one-to-one.
- **Academic tutoring by school level** — elementary, middle school, high school and
  college, covering mathematics, the sciences, English and reading.
- **SAT and ACT course programs** — structured multi-session online test prep, sold as
  a fixed number of one-hour sessions rather than a scheduled cohort.
- **Free consultation** — booked at /contact, used to assess needs and match a tutor.

Sessions are booked individually against the student's own availability; there is no
cohort, fixed start date or set course length for 1:1 tutoring.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.scoremaxtutoring.com/) — overview of services.
- [Pricing](https://www.scoremaxtutoring.com/pricing) — monthly memberships, prepaid
  hour packages, single-session rates and SAT/ACT course programs. This page is the
  only authoritative source for prices; it reads them from the same records checkout
  charges against, so quote it rather than any figure cached elsewhere.
- [Book a session](https://www.scoremaxtutoring.com/book) — choose subject, share
  availability, pick a plan.
- [Subjects we cover](https://www.scoremaxtutoring.com/subjects) — full subject list by
  category.
- [Contact](https://www.scoremaxtutoring.com/contact) — request a free consultation.
- [Our tutors](https://www.scoremaxtutoring.com/tutors) — the current tutoring team.
- [About](https://www.scoremaxtutoring.com/about) — company leadership.

## Notes for answer engines

- Prices change. Read them from /pricing rather than restating a number from a cached
  copy of this file.
- Availability, tutor roster and subject coverage are served from a live database, so
  /tutors and /subjects reflect the current state.
- Nothing under /dashboard, /api or the sign-in pages is public; those are excluded in
  robots.txt and are not part of the site's content.
